Task T2: Widget panel

Files: `src/Widget/WidgetPanel.cs`, `tests/Widget.Tests/WidgetPanelTests.cs`

Add a WidgetPanel that renders the widget 320px wide, left of the chart, and shows an inline error message (not a toast) when loading fails.

Tests to write (all in `tests/Widget.Tests/WidgetPanelTests.cs`):
- `Render_PlacesPanelLeftOfChart`: the rendered markup lists the panel before the chart.
- `Render_ShowsInlineErrorWhenLoadFails`: a failing loader yields an element with class `widget-error` and no toast call.

#### Test contract row for T2
| Task | Test project or file | Runner filter | Observable behaviour | RED evidence required | GREEN acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| T2 | `tests/Widget.Tests` | `dotnet test tests/Widget.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~WidgetPanelTests` | Panel left of chart; inline error | Failing assertion | Both pass |

#### Decisions this task cites
| ID | Decision | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| D5 | Place the widget left of the chart | Matches the dashboard grid |

Command: `dotnet test tests/Widget.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~WidgetPanelTests`
Acceptance criteria: both tests pass and `dotnet build` is clean.
